text:
ana: kicking off change window for messaging-service v1.12.0 to prod-global. plan: canary 8% for 10m -> 40% for 10m. gating: regional p95, global 5xx, and error-budget burn. starting canary now. pls shout if anything fishy.

deploy-bot: rollout started by ana. env=prod-global, version=v1.12.0. steps=[8%:10m,40%:10m]. auto-rollback if p95>600ms or 5xx>0.5% sustained 3m.

monitor-bot: gate snapshot: global p95 baseline=200ms, current p95(5m)=205ms; 5xx baseline=0.05%, current=0.06%. no immediate alerts. sending overlay charts.

ryan: seeing p95 tail jump on /msg/send in ap-southeast region ~6m into canary. spikes to ~520ms in bursts. tracing now.

infra-bot: k8s event: pod messaging-zz12 on node-a9 restarted (OOMKill) at 2026-03-21T18:35:10Z.

sam: logs show worker process hit memory high during large batch decode after v1.12.0 picked up model updates. attaching snippet: `Mar 21 18:35:09 worker decode mem 1.9G/2G`.

ana: (typo - ana) ok hold advancement. keep canary at 8%. monitor-bot, do a diff of top endpoints pre/post and list affected nodes. can we toggle lightweight quantized runtime fallback for the canary?

monitor-bot: delta(5m pre vs 5m post): /msg/send p95 +210ms in ap-southeast, global 5xx +0.18% concentrated in ap-southeast. affected nodes: node-a9, node-b3. recommended mitigation: enable runtime-fallback-quant on canary or divert canary traffic to nodes with heap-boost.

ryan: +1 to divert. infra, can we spin a warmed pool with heap=3G and route the 8% there?

infra-bot: provisioning warmed-pool(2nodes, heap=3G) now. ETA ~90s.

sam: meanwhile, I can toggle quantized fallback for /msg/send at routing layer if we need a faster short-term fix. it reduces mem and cpu but slightly changes latency distribution.

ana: decision: divert the 8% to warmed-pool and enable quantized fallback on the warmed pool routes. do NOT proceed to 40% until stable for 12m. deploy-bot annotate change window: "diverted to warmed-pool + enabled fallback; hold".

deploy-bot: actioned: traffic diverted to warmed-pool; routing rules updated; change window note appended. auto-rollback remains armed.

monitor-bot: 4m after diversion: ap-southeast p95 down from 520ms to 260ms; global 5xx dropping toward baseline 0.07%. no hard alarm. continuing 12m monitor.

ryan: still seeing occasional 500s from node-b3 but much lower rate. looks like one old kubelet version interacting with new runtime. filing INFRA-2117.

infra-bot: ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-2117 (node-b3 kubelet/runtime mismatch).

sam: short-term note for release notes: "paused progression due to memory pressure during model decode on subset of nodes; diverted canary to warmed pool and enabled quantized fallback for canary routes. investigating node kubelet/runtime mismatch."

ana: good. i'll update changelog and add follow-up action items (heap tuning, reproduce in perf lab). sync in 15m. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
